text.en: The modern name "Macedonians" labels the Slavic population of this region since the 7th century as a continuity label, not a judgment of identity. Modern Macedonian national identity formed in the late 19th to mid-20th century (Misirkov 1903, ASNOM 1944, standard language 1945); Bulgarian historiography regards the earlier population as Bulgarian. Samuel's state (976–1018) is regarded by mainstream scholarship as a continuation of the First Bulgarian Empire.
